name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-clima
description: The world's climate on a map and a timeline you can move: the state of El Niño and La Niña, the heat in the ocean, natural disasters and the slow ocean indices, and month by month what happened at the place you declare during the years that looked like this one. Read from NOAA, NASA and the open alert networks; nothing is a forecast of ours.
